children: The JV will own a diversified portfolio of stabilized net lease assets across four countries in Europe: Spain, Ireland, Poland, and the Netherlands. First-year cash annual net operating income is estimated at €67.7M.

KKR-advised capital accounts are set to initially invest €528M to acquire about 49% equity interest in the JV. The retail REIT will retain the remaining ownership interest, and manage the portfolio through its European operating platform.

"We believe the long-term cost and structure of this equity financing create meaningful upside for our shareholders, while further diversifying our capital sources beyond the public markets," said Realty Income's CEO, Sumit Roy.
The transaction is expected to close on September 30.

title: Realty Income, KKR to form euro-denominated JV
